summary_zh: 从青铜时代各古文明厨房专用的切削铜刀，到 18 世纪索林根建立的工匠行会，再到现代不锈钢防锈工艺，菜刀历经数千年演化，始终是人类烹饪备料的核心工具。
summary_en: Evolving from ancient Bronze Age culinary cleavers to 18th-century Solingen steel guilds and modern stainless alloys, the kitchen knife remains the fundamental cooking tool.
